rule_objections: Kinds by position (top-level func = function, var = variable) are a stated choice; a top-level script function is really a method of the script's class, so `function` for a node script's callbacks (_ready, _process) is slightly misleading.
Constructor `_init` not extractable by design (known gap) - a developer would clearly look up the constructor.
findings: 102 expected, 101 correct, 0 spurious, 0 missed outside the known gap; the 1 known-gap miss is `func _init()` at main.gd:24. Names, kinds and lines match on every other declaration (functions incl. static, top-level vars incl. @export/@onready, no locals leaked).

Sample caveat: the 3 largest non-test files in godot-demo-projects have no inner classes, signals, consts, enums or class_name, so those parts of the rule were not exercised (test_one_way_collision.gd 527 lines and global_illumination/test.gd 272 lines were excluded as tests).
